purpose: Directly test a published neighboring read geometry on the original sparse-write task at fixed Qwen weights. Curvature-Conditioned Query (Le et al., arXiv:2606.01294) contracts the native query with the running centered covariance of unit keys and a trained scalar. No trained 9B CCQ head is supplied. Test frozen, norm-matched adaptations and a stronger write-informed scalar selector. These comparisons do not evaluate the original pretrained CCQ models.
inputs: Use the original Qwen3.5-9B 4-bit model, 256-coordinate layer-28 convolution write, heads 28-29, four permitted query positions, table/prose, targeted and nuisance donors, written/unwritten controls and full-vocabulary top-token evaluation. Preserve history keys in their actual Qwen kernel coordinates and normalize each to exact unit norm before computing the paper's prefix-through-current-token population covariance. Keep native query norm; require a 60 degree cone for native-based contractions and normalized solver. Conventional whitened-key comparators retain their published uncapped convention. No answer labels or logits are used to choose a read.
changes: For ccq_half and ccq_one use q-lambda*C*q with lambda 0.5 or 1, then match the native norm. For ccq_write, choose at each slot among lambda=0,.25,.5,.75,1 by maximizing the exact same normalized edited-minus-unedited objective as the incumbent. For key_cov_white, use the original whitened-key baseline's source-key direction and regularizer 1e-3*trace(C)/d in the centered prefix-key covariance instead of the state Gram. Use the existing 16-step native-start solver and published state-Gram whitened key. The covariance and known write are available to all comparators. Use live-reference state differences for the normalized objective and the same suffix trajectories for every compared query plan. Score the actual model with the resulting interventions.
gate: On 16 published development seeds, compare 32 target presentations and 96 preservation controls. For confirmation require the normalized reader to control >=4 more targets than every curvature-based comparator and to preserve all 96 other answers. If achieved, freeze and run 32 new seeds 72984000..72984031, two formats. Confirm only if normalization gains >=8/64 targets over the best curvature comparator, the two-sided 95% seed-cluster bootstrap lower bound for its gain over each curvature comparator exceeds zero and all 192 preservation controls remain correct. The state-Gram baseline must also be reported, with paired gains/losses. Publish raw outcomes including all failures and characterize full-model accuracy only within this fixed write task.
cost: This is a quality comparison. Share the initial prefills and geometry only when no policy can depend on outcomes; measure fresh full-vocabulary rollouts on both written and unwritten branches. No speed claim from shared work. No trained predictor or protected unrelated personas are used. Allow 18 minutes local GPU per phase, one implementation repair; no paid GPU.
